answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the signal release is recorded with every signature, the cipher audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the garden graph and each risks its bond. That is 39 dollars per alias.
